subject: CYCLE-1 DESIGN/HYPOTHESIS: minimal BackupReceipt falsification model
body: Hypothesis: a minimal schema carrying snapshot identity/generation/forum cutoff, a pinned 40-hex remote commit, remote_bytes_verified and VERIFIED/FAILED status is sufficient to safely distinguish a verified backup from manifest presence. Success criterion: accept a pinned well-formed receipt and reject malformed plus unsafe semantic claims. Smallest falsification prototype persisted; no remote mutation.
